query.$select: fiscal_year, upper(trim(title_description)) AS title, count(*) AS employees, median(base_salary) AS median_base, median(coalesce(total_ot_paid, 0) + coalesce(total_other_pay, 0)) AS median_extra
query.$where: pay_basis = 'per Annum' AND leave_status_as_of_june_30 = 'ACTIVE' AND base_salary > 0 AND title_description IS NOT NULL AND ((fiscal_year = 2014 AND agency_start_date <= '2013-07-01T00:00:00') OR (fiscal_year = 2015 AND agency_start_date <= '2014-07-01T00:00:00') OR (fiscal_year = 2016 AND agency_start_date <= '2015-07-01T00:00:00') OR (fiscal_year = 2017 AND agency_start_date <= '2016-07-01T00:00:00') OR (fiscal_year = 2018 AND agency_start_date <= '2017-07-01T00:00:00') OR (fiscal_year = 2019 AND agency_start_date <= '2018-07-01T00:00:00') OR (fiscal_year = 2020 AND agency_start_date <= '2019-07-01T00:00:00') OR (fiscal_year = 2021 AND agency_start_date <= '2020-07-01T00:00:00') OR (fiscal_year = 2022 AND agency_start_date <= '2021-07-01T00:00:00') OR (fiscal_year = 2023 AND agency_start_date <= '2022-07-01T00:00:00') OR (fiscal_year = 2024 AND agency_start_date <= '2023-07-01T00:00:00') OR (fiscal_year = 2025 AND agency_start_date <= '2024-07-01T00:00:00') OR (fiscal_year = 2026 AND agency_start_date <= '2025-07-01T00:00:00'))

headcountQuery.$select: upper(trim(title_description)) AS title, agency_name, payroll_number, count(*) AS employees
headcountQuery.$where: pay_basis = 'per Annum' AND leave_status_as_of_june_30 = 'ACTIVE' AND base_salary > 0 AND title_description IS NOT NULL AND fiscal_year = 2026
